sequenceDiagram
    alt cache hit
    cron job->>data svc: read
    else fall back -> origin: yes
    cron job->>data svc: fetch
    end
---
+----------+     +----------+
| cron job |     | data svc |
+-----+----+     +-----+----+
    +-[alt cache hit]------------+
    | |                |         |
    | | read           |         |
    | +--------------->|         |
    +.[fall back -> origin: yes].+
    | |                |         |
    | | fetch          |         |
    | +--------------->|         |
    | |                |         |
    +----------------------------+
      |                |
